Virtues: Conviction and Instinct

Followers (Bahari/Lilins) hold a heretical history in which Lilith, not Caine, is the true source of vampiric wisdom, and that she taught Caine - and teaches her heirs - through pain. Lilins seek enlightenment by deliberately testing the limits of body and mind (fire-walking, self-mortification, fasting, and similar ordeals), believing pain forces fresh perception that comfort cannot. The Camarilla persecutes the Path; the Sabbat merely tolerates it.

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Refusing pain that offers enlightenment, whether giving it or receiving it from a fellow seeker
  2. Failing to put what you learn into practice
  3. Failing to seek out and awaken those who are ready to join the Path

Typical followers: no dominant clan; some Tzimisce, Lasombra, Malkavian/Nosferatu/Toreador antitribu, a few Kiasyd and Harbingers of Skulls; favors Animalism, Celerity, Fortitude, Obfuscate, Vicissitude.
